messages:
Jordan (partnerships): Heads up — we need alignment on a private-offer bundle with HW partner + SI onboarding. Target launch week May 18. Draft below, pls comment.

Jordan (partnerships): ```
Offer name: Appliance+SI Launch Bundle
Tiers:
  - Bronze: $250k commit -> 4% platform discount + 1mo HW support credit
  - Silver: $500k commit -> 8% platform discount + 2mo HW support + $25k SI credits
  - Gold: $1M commit -> 12% platform discount + 3mo HW support + $60k SI credits + prioritized onboarding
Renewal: 12mo auto-renew unless customer opts out; renewal credit = 10% of prior year commit if upsized
Private SKU notes: separate marketplace SKU for committed buckets; invoice monthly vs. usage.
```

Priya (sales): Love the tiers. Quick Q: what's the minimum discount floor we can show to partners? :thinking_face: we need a clean number for sales decks.

Maya (product): FYI — Silver/Gold will likely push Dedicated capacity reservations for the first 90 days. Need to lock capacity with infra team or we risk throttling.

Ken (eng): Noted. We'll need a new billing SKU and meter mapping for the committed buckets. Also confirm whether caching/batch policies change for these customers.

Luis (finance): Need a back-of-envelope on unit economics before sign-off. What's effective ARR, and gross margin impact at each tier? Can someone drop expected run-rate and cost assumptions?

Jordan (partnerships): @Luis — initial assumptions: OC cost per committed GPU = $8k/mo (est), expected utilization uplift 1.6x with batching, channel incentives baked into SI credits. I'll compile numbers and share by EOD Tues.

Nate (marketing): For launch comms — propose a soft embargo with partner for partner-facing announcement day +1. We should line up joint assets and one Pager + co-branded demo. Who owns partner quotes?

Ivy (legal): Add to checklist: no-pass-through of marketplace credits, explicit renewal opt-out window (30 days), IP and data handling clauses for SI engagements, and audit rights. I'll draft T&Cs and circulate.

Priya (sales): Renewal incentives — can we add a conversion credit for customers that convert from meter->commit within 6 months? That will help surface anchors for reps.

Jordan (partnerships): Good call. Proposal: conversion credit = 20% of difference between new commit and prior usage, applied as one-time credit at renewal. Puts a clear upsell hook.

Ken (eng): For billing mapping: send me the exact SKU strings and meter IDs. I can prototype the mapping to our invoice generator.

Jordan (partnerships): Action items: 1) @Luis get margin calc by Tue EOD; 2) @Ivy draft T&Cs by Wed; 3) @Ken prepare SKU/meter mapping prototype; 4) @Nate coordinate joint assets and embargo; 5) @Priya feed in sales language + renewal play. We'll sync Thurs 9am PT.

PartnerBot: Calendar invite created: "Appliance Bundle GTM & Marketplace Offer sync" Thu 09:00 PT — https://cal.link/redwood/appliance-gmt-sync :calendar:

Priya (sales): Marked. I’ll bring 3 customer use cases for pack pricing.

Maya (product): I'll flag Dedicated capacity tickets and add a 2-week runway for infra to provision.

Luis (finance): I'll start the margin model and post a draft in this thread.

Jordan (partnerships): Thanks everyone — please add any major objections in-thread by EOD so we can finalize the partner-facing one-pager. :thumbsup:
